headline: EU plans to invest 50 billion euros in quantum computing and AI
summary: The European Union plans to invest 50,000 million euros in quantum computing and artificial intelligence. The broader effort aims to reduce the bloc's dependence on US and other non-European technologies.
why: Public investment in quantum computing and AI shapes demand for advanced chips, cloud infrastructure and software across the technology sector. Europe has sought greater technological sovereignty in these fields.
original_headline: La UE planea invertir 50,000 millones de euros en computación cuántica e IA
